basis: Developmental delay and intellectual disability characterize pathogenic 4p duplications; other organ defects vary across duplication sizes and subtypes.
Disease of the fourth cranial nerve; impaired eye movement does not establish direct damage to the eye.
Marrow failure with cytopenias; most idiopathic acquired cases involve immune-mediated destruction of hematopoietic stem cells.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the prostate; lymphoma supplies the immune axis, while the reproductive site has no axis.
Ovarian germ-cell malignancy; reproductive origin without a defining endocrine disorder or another covered organ.
Congenital intestinal obstruction from absence of a normal intestinal opening.
ABCC8-related insulin excess causes persistent hypoglycemia; lasting neurodevelopmental impairment affects roughly 30-50% in severe congenital hyperinsulinism cohorts.
Skeletal dysplasia umbrella defined by severe growth deficiency and abnormal slender bones; additional organ damage is subtype-dependent.
In situ carcinoma confined to the endometrium, a reproductive tissue outside the axes.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the colon or rectum; gastrointestinal origin and lymphoma mechanism define the axes.
Inherited cataract affecting the ocular lens.
Inherited gamma-glutamyl/glutathione metabolic disorders; hemolysis and neurologic injury vary substantially across constituent diseases.
Isolated male infertility from abnormal sperm flagella and motility; reproductive dysfunction has no axis.
Inherited skeletal myopathy umbrella; cardiac disease and respiratory impairment vary by subtype, without a clear group-wide 30% threshold.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability and microcephaly define the syndrome; eyelid ptosis occurs in 80-99%. Minor finger and hair differences lack established dysfunction.
Defined as a malignant neoplasm arising from blood vessels; heterogeneous child annotations do not change the stated vascular origin.
Severe Zellweger disorder: brain maldevelopment and hepatic dysfunction in most; ocular disease commonly exceeds 30%. Skeletal stippling omitted because of the four-axis cap.
Lesions of central supranuclear pathways impair gaze control; direct ocular tissue damage is not established.
Congenital skeletal myopathy; seizures and global developmental delay each reported in 1/2 patients. Diarrhea lacks evidence of direct intestinal damage.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with axonal neuropathy; pigmentary retinopathy in 5/6 and hearing impairment in 11/19. Scoliosis occurs in only 4/25.
Inherited dystrophies with lesions of the corneal stroma.
Abnormally rapid gastric emptying causes intestinal dysfunction and possible malnutrition; episodic hypoglycemia and vasomotor symptoms do not establish other organ damage.
NR2E3-associated retinal degeneration with universal rod-cone dystrophy and visual impairment in the reported cohort.
Defined by autoimmune injury to hepatocytes and red blood cells, causing giant cell hepatitis and hemolytic anemia.
Bone fragility with recurrent fractures, bowing and vertebral collapse; blue sclerae do not establish ocular dysfunction, and dental abnormalities occur in 1-4%.
